_about: Oracle's Elixir's public Google Drive folder (linked from oracleselixir.com/tools/downloads) and the years the site uses. fetch_data.py lists the folder and downloads <year>_LoL_esports_match_data_from_OraclesElixir.csv for each year. A new year: add it here and its settings to YEARS in build_site_data.py.
